claim: rumqttc's MqttOptions defaults to clean_session=true, keep_alive=60s, inflight=100 — meaning a default-configured client discards its pending queue and loses all subscriptions on every reconnect.
stance_target: ha-linux-agent's current unreliability is consistent with default rumqttc settings; reliability requires explicit set_clean_session(false) + stable client_id + re-subscribe
quoted_support: pub fn new(id: S, host: T, port: u16) -> MqttOptions { MqttOptions { ... keep_alive: Duration::from_secs(60), clean_session: true, ... inflight: 100, last_will: None, ...

claim: set_clean_session(false) makes the broker hold client state and replay pending operations on reconnection with the same client_id, and panics if client_id is empty — persistent sessions require a stable non-empty client_id.
stance_target: agent must use a stable per-host client_id (e.g. hostname-derived) with clean_session=false
quoted_support: When set `false`, broker will hold the client state and performs pending operations on the client when reconnection with same `client_id` happens. Local queue state is also held to retransmit packets after reconnection. ... Panics if `clean_session` is false when `client_id` is empty.

claim: rumqttc at main has NO MQTT v5 support — no session_expiry_interval or MqttVersion enum in lib.rs, and eventloop.rs imports mqttbytes::v4 only; it is an MQTT 3.1.1 client where HA's message_expiry_interval (MQTT 5) cannot be negotiated client-side.
stance_target: any design assuming rumqttc can negotiate MQTT 5 features like message expiry or session expiry intervals
quoted_support: No MQTT v5 support in this file — no session_expiry_interval, no MqttVersion enum; eventloop.rs imports mqttbytes::v4 only, so rumqttc at main is MQTT v3.1.1.

claim: rumqttc supports Last Will via the last_will field on MqttOptions (default None) — the mechanism for broker-side availability marking when the agent dies uncleanly.
stance_target: agent should set an LWT on its availability topic so HA marks the host unavailable on agent crash
quoted_support:
/// Last will that will be issued on unexpected disconnect
last_will: Option<LastWill>,
